title: Purge proof media by kind
body:
### Summary

As a quality architect, I want purge to drop each artifact kind after its own retention, so that recordings go before reports.

### Completion Goal

1. [api-trace] state: a ledger with a 40-day-old recording and report, recordings kept 30 days and reports 365; expected: purge tombstones the recording and keeps the report

### Measure

Completion Goal criteria observed

### Threshold

all 1 criteria

### Scenario

Push two packs dated 40 days ago, set the retentions, and run purge.

### Environment

local checkout with synthetic fixtures; never production

### Links

depends-on #41
